title: Princess Animals Clipart Bundle
author: Tanya Kart
description:
Princess Animals Clipart Bundle | 14 Cute Fairy Birthday PNGs | First Birthday Woodland Party Graphics
Create a magical celebration with this Princess and Fairy Birthday Animals Clipart Bundle! This adorable collection includes 14 individual PNG illustrations featuring charming baby animals dressed as princesses and fairies, complete with jeweled crowns, sparkling wings, birthday cakes, cupcakes, balloons and pastel party accessories.
The sweet pink, lavender, mint, peach and gold palette makes this collection perfect for a princess first birthday, fairy-themed baby shower, woodland celebration, nursery projects and personalized children’s gifts.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
• 14 individual PNG clipart files
• High-resolution 300 DPI images
• Transparent backgrounds
• Individual files for easy drag-and-drop use
• Cute princess and fairy animal characters
• Detailed watercolor-style illustrations
• Coordinating pastel birthday palette
• Crisp, clean edges
• Instant digital download
• Suitable for personal and commercial projects
THE COLLECTION FEATURES
• Princess bunny with gift
• Fairy koala with number-one candle
• Crowned tiger in pink castle
• Princess raccoon on giant cupcake
• Baby dragon with crown and party horn
• Fairy fox holding birthday cake
• Fairy kitten holding pink donut
• Princess bunny holding cupcake
• Fairy teddy bear with balloons
• Crowned lion with birthday cupcake
• Floral woodland animal characters
• Pastel birthday dessert table
• Happy Birthday animal group
• Coordinating birthday-party animal scene
PERFECT FOR
• Princess first-birthday invitations
• Fairy birthday party décor
• Woodland birthday celebrations
• Baby-shower invitations
• Birthday cards and thank-you notes
• Cake toppers and cupcake decorations
• Party favor bags
• Printable banners
• Stickers and planner designs
• Nursery wall art
• T-shirts and bodysuits
• Mugs and tumblers
• Tote bags
• Sublimation projects
• Scrapbooking and memory books
• Personalized children’s gifts
• Digital party invitations
• Small-business merchandise
PLEASE NOTE
This is a digital download only. No physical item will be shipped. Preview backgrounds, mockups, shirts, mugs and decorative presentation elements are not included. The number-one candle is part of its illustrated design and cannot be edited separately. Colors may vary slightly depending on your screen, printer and materials.
